## RX-TX-Tracker v2.0.39

### Release summary
- Added explicit 90-day `Needs Action` lifecycle handling for patient workflows.
- Patient list now surfaces `Needs Action` filter/badge to help operators focus on expired-cycle records.
- Workflow step entry is no longer fully blocked after 90 days when a tracker is still active.
- Updated deployment artifacts to version `2.0.39`.

### What’s included
- `controllers/patientController.js` (`needsAction` classification, workflow-open detection)
- `controllers/rxController.js` (workflow update path 90-day exception handling)
- `public/js/patients.js` (filtering + banner UX)
- `views/patients.ejs` (new filter option + banner area)
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `package.json`
- `OPERATIONS_MANUAL.md`
- `.github/RELEASE_NOTES.md`
- `dist/server-update-2.0.39.zip` (build artifact)

### QA check list
- [x] Open Patient list and verify `Needs Action` option exists.
- [x] Confirm expired patients with incomplete workflow appear in that filter.
- [x] Confirm banner updates with patient count and one-click filter action.
- [x] Confirm workflow steps remain editable on active cycles after day 90.
- [x] Confirm service-date change control still enforces rules unless override is enabled.
- [x] Build and package executable with `npm run build:exe`.
